xtrm-xl9p.description: Move memory gate enforcement from Stop hook (non-blocking nudge) to PreToolUse on Bash(bd close*) matcher. Blocks the close until agent saves a memory or explicitly acks nothing novel. Per-issue ack key: bd kv set 'memory-acked:<issueId>'. Message must be compact — single continuous line, machine-oriented, minimal visual noise. Keep existing Stop gate as fallback.
xtrm-xl9p.notes: Release triage 2026-05-04: current bd close path already enforces per-issue memory ack (observed MEMORY_GATE_BLOCK on bd close). Keep deferred unless a follow-up proves a missing hook-install path remains.
